subject: Co-host opportunity: Redwood x Nimbus — Scaling LLM inference for analytics
messages:
From: Kate Morris <kate@nimbus.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Co-host — Redwood x Nimbus intro

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for reaching out — this sounds like a great fit for our analytics audience. We're especially interested in the 'cost vs latency' framing and a short engineer-friendly demo.

Before we lock in a date, can you send a short co-host agenda and a suggested promotional plan (audience segments, timing, tracking links)? Also cc'ing our partnerships inbox for scheduling.

I've attached a rough agenda we use for partner co-hosts (Nimbus_cohost_agenda.pdf).

Best,
Kate Morris
Head of Partnerships
Nimbus Analytics
attachments: Nimbus_cohost_agenda.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Morris <kate@nimbus.ai>
Cc: Nimbus Analytics Partnerships <partners@nimbus.ai>
Date: 2026-10-01T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Co-host — Redwood x Nimbus intro

Hi Kate —

Fantastic, thanks for the quick reply and for the agenda. Attaching a first draft of our promo email and a tracking matrix so we can map UTM parameters to HubSpot.

High-level suggestions:
- Target: analytics engineers, platform teams, and BI leads (we'll provide targeted lists)
- Two weeks promotional period with 3 email touches + 2 reminder bursts for registrants who haven't added to calendar
- Timezone windows: PT-friendly send for West Coast, staggered in the EU window for global reach (we can localize subject lines)
- RSVP CTA: single-click registration (Zoom link + add-to-calendar) + post-reg micro-survey (2 questions)

Attachments: draft_email_copy_v3.html, tracking_matrix_v2.xlsx

Would you prefer the webinar to be demo-first (20m demo, 10m Q&A) or a panel discussion with a short demo slot? We can adapt copy and audience targeting either way.

Thanks — looping in Marissa (events ops) and Connor (growth) to scope the lists and cadence.

— Stephanie Nguyen
Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198
attachments: draft_email_copy_v3.html (text/html), tracking_matrix_v2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-02T08:33:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Co-host — Redwood x Nimbus intro (promo plan + asks)

Marissa / Connor — forwarding Kate's note and the Nimbus agenda.

Quick asks so we can reply with a concrete plan by EOD Friday: 
1) Segment: can we pull "analytics-engineers" and "platform-engineering" lists from the growth repo? Target net 8k contacts (US + EU); include nurture suppression for existing Nimbus customers.
2) Tracking: Connor, please add UTM variants for the 3 subject line tests and a 2x reminder split (reminder timing: 48h before + 3h before). See the attached tracking_matrix_v2.xlsx for suggested params.
3) Creative: Marissa, I made two subject line options in the draft_email_copy_v3.html. We should localize the EU subject to mention "UTC-friendly live time" — do you have capacity for a single localized variant?

Decisions needed: demo-first vs panel. My recommendation: demo-first with a short panel Q&A to keep it technical and reduce no-shows.

Also note: Nimbus asked for a short post-registration micro-survey. We can use a 2-question poll to collect priority topics and team size — that will help with the follow-up cadences.

Thanks — Steph

All — quick status update after reviewing lists and tracking: 
- Audience: we can deliver ~7.6k net contacts after suppression (US: 5.1k, EU: 2.5k). I flagged ~400 high-priority enterprise accounts for an account-based follow-up.
- Tracking: added UTMs for subject-test A/B (subjectA=demo-first, subjectB=panel-angle) and a separate UTM campaign for the reminder bursts. Links are in tracking_matrix_v2.xlsx; I've also added HubSpot campaign ID HBS-20382.
- Sends: recommend staggered sends over two days to avoid throttling our dedicated provider windows (Day 1: US mid-morning PT, Day 2: EU localized sends). Reminder schedule: 48h reminder + 3h last-chance (both automated via Zoom Events).
- Creative: Marissa, I liked Subject A but added an engineer-focused preheader option: "How to cut per-token cost by 3x without accuracy loss" — works well for A/B.

Next actions: Marissa to finalize localized HTML by EOD Thursday; Steph to confirm final agenda (demo timing) with Kate; I'll seed the tracking links into HubSpot and schedule the Zoom Event registration page.

— Connor
